newsitem.title: POLAND: FORD REJECTS ALL BIDS AT POLISH CP AUCTION.
newsitem.headline: FORD REJECTS ALL BIDS AT POLISH CP AUCTION.

text.p: Ford Credit Europe Plc., the financial arm of Ford Motor Company rejected all investor bids at its Friday commercial paper auction, ABN AMRO Poland, the co-arranger of the issue, said in a statement.
Despite stable demand at all Ford's auctions so far, the issuer was not satisfied with the prices at Friday's auction, a source close to the tender said.
The 11 million zloty offer was a part of Ford's 200 million zloty borrowing programme organized by Bank Handlowy. The bids at today's tender were just above 11 million zlotys.
The overall outstanding debt of Ford under the scheme is now at about 100 million zlotys.
At the last auction on November 20, 1996, it sold 8.5 million zlotys worth of two-month paper at an average yield of 19.25 percent after investors bid for 9.5 million.
